+---
+assignees:

+- 01M3FN95AM98RJSTCVQ8G1Z7KE
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'ModelPool: the pool entry owns the work queue, and an embedder handle runs each embed call through it'
+---
+## Why
+All users of one model must share one work queue. Today the router MLX container creates the `GenerationQueue` (`LiveModelLoader.swift:60`), so the queue is not part of the pool. Also, embeddings do not go through a queue today (`RoutedEmbedder.swift:51`). The metadata registry needs a queued embedder most.
+
+## What to do
+1. Each pool entry creates and owns one `GenerationQueue`. All holds of one key get the same queue.
+2. A hold gives access to the queue of its entry.
+3. Add a public embedder handle for the `.embedding` role. It has `dimension` and `embed(texts:)`. Each `embed(texts:)` call runs through the queue of the entry. The handle keeps the hold, so the model stays resident while the handle exists.
+4. The embed operation of the opaque container comes from a small protocol that the loader result conforms to. Do not add MLX to the target.
+5. Keep the re-entry guard of the queue: a submission that waits inside an open submission on the same queue is refused.
+
+## Acceptance criteria
+- [ ] Test: two holds of one key get the same queue instance.
+- [ ] Test: concurrent `embed(texts:)` calls on one key run one at a time, in FIFO order.
+- [ ] Test: the model is not evicted while an embedder handle exists.
+- [ ] Test: a cancelled embed call does not block the next call in the queue.
+- [ ] The public API has doc comments. `swift test` passes. #model-pool #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
